patches.title: Separate the browser protocol from Host API implementation and decompose ApiProxy
patches.reason: The official ownership cycle and monolithic ApiProxy make browser consumers depend on Host implementation details and make independent API domains change together.
patches.retirement: Retire when official DSH provides an acyclic browser-safe protocol owner and ApiProxy domain assembly with equivalent behavior.
patches.reviewNote: Initial downstream registration at the currently validated official base.

patches.title: Keep repaired analyzer and client view responsibilities separated
patches.reason: The official analyzer and several browser components combine independent graph, state, command, and rendering responsibilities in single oversized symbols.
validation: vitest run packages/typert/generator/tests packages/client/ui-trajectory/tests packages/client/ui-directory-picker-browse/tests packages/client/ui-conversation/tests packages/client/ui-workspace/tests
patches.retirement: Retire each owned path when official DSH adopts equivalent responsibility splits or exposes a stable Lumi-side replacement seam.
patches.reviewNote: Initial downstream registration at the currently validated official base.

patches.title: Use one DSH product identity and version source
patches.reason: Official protocol clients, servers, subprocess adapters, and HTTP providers otherwise publish independent hardcoded product versions and User-Agent values.
patches.retirement: Retire when official DSH owns one equivalent version and attribution module consumed by every listed integration.
patches.reviewNote: Initial downstream registration at the currently validated official base.

patches.title: Let settings owners declare configuration-client exposure
patches.reason: A Host-maintained namespace allowlist couples the configuration surface to every settings producer and silently drifts when providers are added or removed.
patches.retirement: Retire when official DSH settings registrations carry an equivalent owner-declared audience consumed by the Host API.
patches.reviewNote: Initial downstream registration at the currently validated official base.

patches.title: Centralize client visual constants in ui-theme
patches.reason: Component-owned RGB and hexadecimal values bypass the active theme and make visual changes require unrelated component edits.
patches.retirement: Retire when official DSH provides equivalent semantic and static theme tokens and all listed components consume them.
patches.reviewNote: Initial downstream registration at the currently validated official base.

patches.title: Prevent downstream architecture regressions
patches.reason: The fork needs executable limits for dependency cycles, repaired source concentrations, source/artifact separation, product identity ownership, client colors, and its explicit upstream patch inventory.
patches.retirement: Retain as fork governance while Lumi carries any local DSH patch; narrow individual checks when their corresponding patch is retired.
patches.reviewNote: Initial downstream registration at the currently validated official base.

patches.title: Validate persistence snapshots without inventing a non-negative timestamp rule
patches.reason: The public persistence snapshot type accepts safe integer timestamps, including valid pre-epoch values, while the SQLite query projection must still reject fractional or malformed values from provider implementations.
patches.retirement: Retire when official DSH validates the same public snapshot contract or narrows the service definition with an equivalent documented timestamp rule.
patches.reviewNote: Initial downstream registration at the currently validated official base.

patches.title: Bound high-cardinality desktop runtime paths
patches.reason: Official browser and Host paths otherwise retain unbounded event and Session state, rewrite high-frequency projection checkpoints through JSON, scan complete session catalogs and history prefixes on hot paths, and mount every sidebar row.
validation: vitest run packages/host/apiproxy/tests packages/api/remotes/tests/agent-lookup.spec.ts packages/client/connection/tests packages/client/runtime/tests packages/client/ui-workspace/tests packages/bundle/web-app/tests/performance-composition.spec.ts apps/desktop/tests/diagnostics.spec.ts
patches.retirement: Retire each selector when official DSH provides equivalent bounded queues, indexed immutable session pagination, bounded browser residency, virtualized Workspace rows, row-level projection persistence, and linear history correlation.
patches.reviewNote: The downstream performance limits and repair semantics are absent from the currently validated official base.

patches.title: Keep desktop client failures recoverable and keyboard paths complete
patches.reason: Official client surfaces otherwise strand users on startup and Workspace action failures, leave modal and menu keyboard behavior incomplete, present unconfirmed Workspace reorder results, and allow desktop DeepSeek credentials to be persisted before the unsaved key is verified against the provider.
patches.retirement: Retire when official DSH provides equivalent localized startup and Workspace-action recovery, Host-confirmed reorder presentation, complete modal and menu keyboard behavior, and pre-persistence provider verification for desktop credentials.
patches.reviewNote: The startup and Workspace recovery, keyboard, confirmed-reorder, and credential-verification behavior is absent from the currently validated official base.
